title: I want to get into AI trading, but I don’t know where to start.
author: Creative_Car7894
selftext:
hi evrevone, i want start  AI trading, but I don’t know where to start. i see tiktok video that Traidingpilot is a good platfor to start ai traiding but i not believe thats true. maybe someone can help my how to start and how much need money to start. 

THIS IS NOT A REKLAM TRIDINGPILOT I SEE VIDEO AND  I WAN START EARN MONEY WITCH TRAIDING

comments.author: boss-man-007
comments.body: do you know about trading? are you an trader in the first place?

replies.author: Inevitable_Can8270
replies.body: I think you should learn about trading first before getting into AI trading.

replies.author: Deep90
replies.body: They can learn both as long as it is a paper account, but I would also say to learn how to do it yourself before throwing an AI at it.

replies.author: boss-man-007
replies.body: learn trading properly ,find and edge ,it will take atleast an year or two

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
skip the platform from the tiktok video, most of those sell the dream and the subscription is how they get paid. start with zero money: one simple rule, test it on old prices, then practice it on fake money for a month.

if it's US stocks, Quantradin is the practice spot I made for that, you type the rule and it runs on fake money at no cost. quantradin.com

which market were you thinking of?

replies.author: Creative_Car7894
replies.body: It doesn’t matter to me which market it is; I just want to start earning money online. I’ve been looking for ways to do this for almost two years, trying things out, but nothing has worked—and then I came across this video, and it caught my interest.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: two years of trying things is a lot, and I'm sorry most of it didn't pay. I'll be straight with you though: trading is a slow way to earn online, not a fast one, and most people who start lose money in the first year. if you try it, keep it on fake money until you've followed one rule for months.

replies.author: Creative_Car7894
replies.body: Which indicators and strategies on TradingView should I use to learn or to potentially increase my earnings?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: to learn I'd keep it to two: a 200-day moving average to tell you the trend, and RSI to spot pullbacks inside it. only buy a dip when price is above the 200. no indicator raises earnings by itself, it just gives you a rule you can test and stick to.

comments.author: Headjacked
comments.body: Setup a paper trade account and learn that way. Most people will lose money the first 2 to 3 yrs, like 95% of all retail traders. I also at first used Autotrader and watched how my pilot traded. This is measured over yrs not months, time is what makes you money in the markets. Took me over 3 yrs to stop bleeding money and actually start seeing gains from investing. There'S A LOT OF BS on you tube, most are straight up lying!!!  Good luck!!

comments.author: Arthe31
comments.body: Honestly it will make sense to get to AI trading when you already have knowledge of normal Trading. If you also have a very good knowledge of A.I. that could help. But jumping directly into the den is not a good idea because I have a hard time imagining how you want to set up something you dont understand at all...

comments.author: profittoinvest
comments.body:
Check out the Cornix platform. There is marketplace with offers bots that you can connect to, run backtests on, and test using a demo account to see how they perform. 

Important thing - keep in mind that the results shown for these bots may differ from the results on a live account. For one thing, you are joining while a bot is already running, so the sequence of signals you experience will be different. The results you see there are provided by Cornix they are the ones who track them so the data is not manipulated or inflated.

comments.author: Square-Buy-7403
comments.body: First get experience trading without ai and then automate your process once you are successful. Trying to create a trading bot without even understand or having any experience in the market is asking for trouble. You won't know what to tweak or why anything is succeeding or not succeeding.

comments.author: Technical-Machine-90
comments.body: Start trading, lose money, learn, repeat

comments.author: Owl_Better
comments.body: What’s the point of AI trading if you have to learn it all ahead of time😂😎😂

comments.author: TakeDeadAi
comments.body: Forget about it. It doesn’t work.

comments.author: ApartmentOk3498
comments.body: learn the basics first and paper trade for a while

comments.author: TradeyAI-R
comments.body:
Good call being skeptical of TikTok. If your goal is to make money, start simple: invest in a broad market ETF like the S&P 500 first. It moves less, and it teaches you how you actually feel when you're down money. Then move on to individual stocks. And practice with paper trading (fake money) before using real money. 

How much to start? $0. Paper trading is free. When you go real, only use money you can afford to lose.

I'm building TradeyAI, an AI trading agent for crypto and onchain US stocks. It's free right now, with backtesting and paper trading built in, so you can test ideas with zero risk. It also explains why it entered or exited every trade, so you actually learn from it. Access is whitelist-only right now. Let me know if you want to give it a try, or search "TradeyAI" to check it out first.
